hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve with liquidity sourced from Euler Vault Kit vaults. Handles full swap execution in beforeSwap via beforeSwapReturnsDelta: takes input tokens into Euler vaults and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults while enforcing a custom curve invariant. Blocks native CLAMM liquidity addition and donations.
